scope: Every published HTML document and its visitor-visible prose, headings, link labels, controls, and search/social description metadata.
method: Human semantic review against the cited authoritative sources. Exact quotations require exact-text verification; factual paraphrases require direct support; interpretation must be labeled; unsupported material is corrected or removed. The CI hash invalidates approval whenever published wording changes.
limitations: This ledger records semantic review; a hash is only a change detector and is not evidence that a claim is true. Script-embedded answer banks are governed separately by source_integrity_inventory.py and fail-closed runtime policy.

Prior substantive source review preserved. Scene interpretations and source/study routes reviewed separately in hero-details.js.
